We're hiring the lead systems engineer for a new product that will be fielded across many vehicle types. You'll join early, while the architecture is still taking shape, and carry it through design reviews, integration and test, and into production. You'll define how the system installs on a vehicle, how it gets and distributes power, and how it connects to the vehicle and the network. You'll also define how other Anduril teams and outside partners integrate with it. Other products will be built around those interfaces for years, so they need to be right. You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, software and mission systems engineers. You'll also work with product teams in other Anduril business lines and with government engineers and operators. Experience designing vehicles or major vehicle systems at an OEM, supplier or defense prime is valuable in this role. You'll report to the Ground Maneuver Chief Engineer and work day to day with the product and program manager. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Hardware Test Engineer, Energy Storage
jobs.department: Engineering & Technology
jobs.description_text: Position Summary: Join Redwood Materials to validate the high-voltage power electronics behind the world’s energy storage systems. You’ll design and run validation tests on components and assemblies operating at 400–2000VDC and 480–800VAC. You’ll work directly from schematics, Altium layouts, and datasheets to understand switching topologies, gate drive, isolation, protection, and thermal behavior, then use that understanding to build sharper tests. When something fails, you’ll probe the circuit, isolate the fault, and drive root cause to the component level. You’ll design and source custom PCBAs for characterization, build electrical-focused test infrastructure with mechanical and software elements, and write Python tools to automate testing and analyze data. Working alongside design, reliability, and abuse engineers on FMEAs and test plans, you’ll turn complex data into design and process improvements that ship. If you thrive at the bench, love finding the real cause of a failure, and want your work to matter from day one, this is your role. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Design, set up, and execute validation tests on high-voltage power electronics components and assemblies Read and work directly from schematics, Altium layouts, and datasheets to understand circuit behavior and inform test design Debug and diagnose hardware hands-on — probe circuits, isolate faults, and drive root cause investigations to the component level Design, fabricate, and source custom PCBAs
